unsupported: Unsupported database dependency: mongoose, and a mongodb service is defined in docker-compose.yml. Deployz does not support MongoDB. Use PostgreSQL.
Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yml defines 2 application services (api, rag_api). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
This app is configured to run a database migration on deploy but the manifest does not require a database — Deployz cannot run migrations without a provisioned database
